the_two_clauses_that_disagree.enumeration: R11 sentence 1: a donor's weights are used in EXACTLY TWO ways -- compile reads and live address reads. A benchmark is neither, so the enumeration does not authorise it.
the_two_clauses_that_disagree.prohibition: R11 sentence 2: no forward pass, loop, sampling or inference may sit in the deployment loop or in any mechanism whose output reaches an answer. A benchmark sits in neither, so the prohibition does not bar it.

benchmark_process_category_under_R11_as_.category_as_written: UNAUTHORISED BUT NOT BARRED -- outside the two sanctioned uses, outside the prohibited locations. R11 as written has no clause that decides it, which is why D-MPE12-09 is a ruling and not a reading.
benchmark_process_category_under_R11_as_.what_the_audit_does_with_that: the audit enforces the prohibition clause mechanically, whichever way the enumeration clause is ruled: if the ruling permits an offline benchmark, the audit is the thing that proves it stays off the answer path; if the ruling forbids it, the audit is the thing that catches it
benchmark_process_category_under_R11_as_.sanctioned_control_arm_is_a_third_thing: the text-distillation arm R11 names is sanctioned by the rule itself and is a different act (it emits text to train on); it is registered as offline_control and audited on the same graph, not exempted by its name

d_mpe12_09_structural_position.clause: H2 / the >=10x per-association read cost against autoregressive inference
d_mpe12_09_structural_position.denominator_requires: a donor-executing act in the same process that reports it
d_mpe12_09_structural_position.if_the_ruling_is_no: no donor-executing act is permitted anywhere, so the denominator cannot be produced at all and the >=10x clause has no executable form in the program
d_mpe12_09_structural_position.if_the_ruling_is_yes: the denominator may be produced only by a process that never joins an answer, so the ratio exists solely as an offline artifact; the answer path can never compute it or carry it
d_mpe12_09_structural_position.common_consequence: under either ruling the >=10x claim has no executable form ON THE ANSWER PATH. The only way it could get there is the file-mediated join this audit also checks, which is why that check exists
